FN-LHV2AW-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 244
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Danny Crawford
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/11/2023
REVISED - 04/11/2023
House Bill 244 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Office of Indigent Defense
Services (OIDS), paid from the Fair Trial Tax Fund and funded by the State General Fund, by
an undetermined amount by increasing the cap on attorney fees for guardians ad litem in
juvenile dependency cases from $2,500, under current law, to $5,000, as provided by this bill.
According to OIDS, 366 claims exceeded the current cap in Fiscal Year 2022.

FN-LHV2AW-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 244
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Danny Crawford
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/10/2023
House Bill 244 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation General Fund could
increase the obligations of the Office of Indigent Defense Services (OIDS), paid from the Fair
Trial Tax Fund and funded by the State General Fund, by an undetermined amount by increasing
the cap on attorney fees for guardians ad litem in juvenile dependency cases from $2,500, under
current law, to a maximum of $5,000, as provided by this bill. According to OIDS, 366 claims
exceeded the current cap in Fiscal Year 2022.
